sn22.1:1.1: Saṃyutta-Nikāya Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa || || 1 Evam me sutaṃ ||
sn22.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye || || 2
sn22.1:1.3: Atha kho Nakulapitā gahapati yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Nakulapitā gahapati Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn22.1:2.1: Aham asmi bhante jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇātaṅko ||
sn22.1:2.2: aniccadassāvī kho panāham bhante Bhagavato manobhāvanīyānaṃ ca bhikkhūnaṃ ||
sn22.1:2.5: yam mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti || || 4
sn22.1:3.1: Evam etaṃ gahapati evam etaṃ gahapati
sn22.1:3.2: āturo te gahapati kāyo addhabhūto pariyonaddho ||
sn22.1:3.3: Yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyam pariharanto muhuttam pi ārogyam paṭijāneyya kim aññatra bālyā || ||
sn22.1:3.5: āturakāyassa me sato cittam anāturam bhavissatīti ||
sn22.1:3.6: Evaṃ hi te gahapati sikkhitabban ti || || 5
sn22.1:4.1: Atha kho Nakulapitā gahapati Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yenāyasmā Sāriputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 6 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Nakulapitaraṃ gahapatim āyasmā Sāriputto etad avoca || ||
sn22.1:4.4: alattha no ajja Bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ savanāyāti || ||
sn22.1:5.2: idānāham bhante Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto ti || ||
sn22.1:5.3: Yathā katham pana tvaṃ gahapati Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto ti || || 7
sn22.1:5.4: Idhāham bhante yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃ || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃ || ekam antaṃ nisinno kho ham bhante Bhagavantam etad avocaṃ || ||
sn22.1:5.5: Aham asmi bhante jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo anuppatto āturakāyo abhikkhaṇātaṅko ||
sn22.1:5.6: aniccadassāvī panāham bhante Bhagavato manobhāvanīyānaṃ ca bhikkhūnam ||
sn22.1:5.9: yam mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti || ||
sn22.1:6.1: Evaṃ vutte mam bhante Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn22.1:6.2: Evam etaṃ gahapati evam etaṃ gahapati ||
sn22.1:6.3: āturo yaṃ gahapati kāyo addhabhūto pariyonaddho ||
sn22.1:6.4: yo hi gahapati imaṃ kāyam pariharanto muhuttam pi ārogyam paṭijāneyya kim aññatra bālyā || ||
sn22.1:6.6: āturakāyassa me sato cittam anāturam bhavissatīti ||
sn22.1:6.8: Evaṃ khvāhaṃ bhante Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya amatena abhisitto ti || || 8
sn22.1:7.1: Na hi pana taṃ gahapati paṭibhāsi Bhagavantam uttariṃ paṭipucchituṃ || ||
sn22.1:7.2: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca || Kittāvatā ca pana āturakāyo hi kho hoti no ca āturacitto ti || || 9
sn22.1:7.3: Dūrato pi kho mayam bhante āgaccheyyāma āyasmato Sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham aññātum ||
sn22.1:7.4: sādhu vatāyasmantaṃ yeva Sāriputtam paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho ti || || 10
sn22.1:8.1: Tena hi gahapati suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti || ||
sn22.1:8.2: Evam bhante ti kho Nakulapitā gahapati āyasmato Sāriputtassa paccassosi || || 11
sn22.1:9.1: ca gahapati āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca || || 12
sn22.1:9.2: Idha gahapati assutavā puthujjano ariyānam adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānam adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.1:9.3: rūpam attato samanupassati || rūpavantam vā attānam attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:9.4: Ahaṃ rūpam mama rūpan ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:9.5: tassa Aham rūpam mama rūpan ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpam pariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:10.1: Vedanam attato samanupassati vedanāvantam vā attānam attani vā vedanam vedanāya vā attānam
sn22.1:10.2: Aham vedanā mama vedanā ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:10.3: tassa Ahaṃ vedanā mama vedanā ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā vedanā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:11.1: Saññam attato samanupassati || saññāvantam vā attānam attani vā saññaṃ saññāya vā attānam
sn22.1:11.2: Ahaṃ saññā mama saññā ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:11.3: tassa Ahaṃ saññā mama saññā ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā saññā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:12.1: Saṅkhāre attato samanupassati || saṅkhāravantam vā attānam attani vā saṅkhāre saṅkhāresu vā attānam
sn22.1:12.2: Ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārā ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:12.3: tassa Ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārāti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino te saṅkhārā vipariṇamanti aññathā honti ||
sn22.1:13.1: Viññāṇam attato samanupassati || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānam
sn22.1:13.2: Ahaṃ viññāṇam mama viññāṇan ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:13.3: tassa Ahaṃ viññāṇam mama viññāṇanti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:13.5: Evaṃ kho gahapati āturakāyo ceva hoti āturacitto ca || || 18
sn22.1:14.1: Kathañca gahapati āturakāyo pi kho hoti no ca āturacitto || 19
sn22.1:14.2: Idha gahapati sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
sn22.1:14.3: na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantam vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpam na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ
sn22.1:14.4: Ahaṃ rūpam mama rūpan ti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:14.5: tassa Aham rūpam mama rūpanti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:15.1: Na vedanam attato samanupassati na vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā vedanaṃ na vedanāya vā attānam
sn22.1:15.2: Aham vedanā mama vedanā ti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:15.3: tassa Aham vedanā mama vedanāti apariyuṭṭhatthāyino sā vedanā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:16.1: Na saññam attato samanupassati || na saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā saññaṃ na saññāya vā attānam
sn22.1:16.2: Ahaṃ saññā mama saññā ti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:16.3: tassa Ahaṃ saññā mama saññāti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino sā saññā vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:17.1: Na saṅkhāre attato samanupassati na saṅkhāravantam vā attānaṃ na attani vā saṅkhāre na saṅkhāresu vā attānam
sn22.1:17.2: Ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārā ti na pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti || ||
sn22.1:17.3: tassa Ahaṃ saṅkhārā mama saṅkhārā ti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino te saṅkhārā vipariṇamanti aññathā honti ||
sn22.1:18.1: Na viññāṇam attato samanupassati na viññānavantam vā attānaṃ na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānam
sn22.1:18.2: Aham viññāṇam mama viññāṇan ti na pariyuṭṭhatthāyī hoti ||
sn22.1:18.3: tassa Aham viññāṇam mama viññāṇan ti apariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyino taṃ viññāṇam vipariṇamati aññathā hoti ||
sn22.1:18.5: Evam kho gahapati āturakāyo hoti no ca āturacitto ti || || 25
sn22.1:19.2: attamano Nakulapitā gahapati āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhāsitam abhinandīti || || 1
